title: Explain Actions secret naming rules
steps: Inspect the open Add secret dialog.
Enter 1DEPLOY_KEY as the Name and staging-access as the Value.
Click Confirm and inspect the validation at Name and the retained inputs.
Hover over Name to inspect its contextual naming guidance.

video_guide.summary: Enter the invalid secret name, confirm it, and inspect the contextual naming guidance at Name.

chapters.label: Inspect the open Add secret dialog.

chapters.note: The empty Name field shows a sample secret-name placeholder.

chapters.label: Enter 1DEPLOY_KEY as Name and staging-access as Value.

chapters.note: Name contains 1DEPLOY_KEY and Value contains staging-access.
Name is focused and a validation popup says Please match the requested format.

chapters.label: Hover Name to inspect its contextual naming guidance.

chapters.note: The tooltip says Name must start with a letter or underscore, contain only letters, numbers, and underscores, and must not start with GITEA_ or GITHUB_.
The naming tooltip, validation popup, and both entered values are visible together.
